adaptation_note: Flutter planner spec adapted to a React 18 + Vite + TS + Tailwind + shadcn/ui SPA. No Dart, no build_runner, no flutter analyze. The engineering gate for every code task is `npx tsc --noEmit` (or the repo's typecheck script) plus `npx eslint` on the touched files. Test infrastructure was verified ABSENT in this repo (no *.test.* / *.spec.* files, no vitest/jest config), so no test files are scheduled; per G10 the test-writer tasks below are manual-verification owners, not fabricated automated suites.

owners.ui-builder: Creates new UI components and pages (src/pages/CVView.tsx, src/components/cv/*).
owners.ui-binding: Wires existing UI to new behaviour (Hero.tsx, Navbar.tsx, src/lib/utils.ts, src/App.tsx, AnalyticsSection.tsx).
owners.data (api layer): Vercel serverless handlers under api/*.ts; owner is "data" with layer "api".
owners.test-writer: Manual verification owner; no automated suite is feasible (no test runner in repo).

tasks.title: Add cvviews reset scope to api/visit-reset.ts BEFORE any view key can be written
acceptance_criteria: SCOPES.cv stays byte-for-byte identical: ["v:cv", "v:cv:*", "v:cvday:*", "v:cvuniq:*"].
New SCOPES.cvviews = ["v:cvview:*", "v:cvviewday:*", "v:cvviewuniq:*"] is added as a separate entry.
Scope guard at the existing `if (scope !== "visits" && scope !== "cv")` widened to also accept "cvviews"; 400 message updated to "Invalid scope. Use 'visits', 'cv' or 'cvviews'.".
No glob in SCOPES.cv matches any v:cvview* key and no glob in SCOPES.cvviews matches any v:cv:* key (literal-prefix reasoning: 'v:cv:*' requires the prefix 'v:cv:' while the real key is 'v:cvview:').
deletePatterns(), the ADMIN_PIN auth path, method guard and response shape are otherwise unchanged.
tasks.verification: Static check: `npx tsc --noEmit` typechecks; then manually diff the SCOPES object and the guard against the strings recorded above. Behavioral check (required before deploy, needs credentials): against a scratch Redis set both `v:cv:flutter=1` and `v:cvview:flutter=1`, POST /api/visit-reset with {scope:"cv"}, assert `v:cv:flutter` is gone AND `v:cvview:flutter` still exists; repeat with {scope:"cvviews"} and assert the inverse. If no scratch Redis is available, record the behavioral check as NOT RUN with the reason.
tasks.notes: HIGH RISK — this is the reason the task is ordered first. The architecture (§7.6, ARCH2-02) verified that today `v:cv:*` does NOT match `v:cvview:*` only because of the literal colon after 'cv'; a future widening or a typo like `v:cv*` would delete both families in one confirm. Shipping the API view keys (TASK-02) before this scope exists leaves an admin with no safe way to clear views, and any later 'fix' to the cv scope risks wiping downloads. Must land in the same deploy as, or before, TASK-02.

tasks.title: api/download-cv.ts: add mode=view (inline) and split the counting namespace between views and downloads
acceptance_criteria: `mode` is parsed with the same array-safe rule as `track`: `const rawMode = Array.isArray(request.query?.mode) ? request.query?.mode[0] : request.query?.mode; const isViewMode = rawMode === "view";` and the VercelRequest query type gains `mode?: string | string[];`.
Content-Disposition is computed as `${isViewMode ? "inline" : "attachment"}; filename="${cvFile.fileName}"`; Content-Type stays application/pdf and Cache-Control stays no-store.
`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` is set on both the inline and attachment responses.

Counting block derives `const ns = isViewMode ? "cvview" : "cv";` and builds totalKey=`v:${ns}:${track}`, dayKey=`v:${ns}day:${track}:${day}`, uniqKey=`v:${ns}uniq:${track}:${day}`; the 90*24*60*60 TTL is applied to dayKey and uniqKey in both branches.
INVARIANT (view): mode=view writes ONLY v:cvview:<track>, v:cvviewday:<track>:<day>, v:cvviewuniq:<track>:<day> and never touches v:cv:*, v:cvday:*, v:cvuniq:*.

INVARIANT (download): absent mode, mode=download, or any unknown mode writes ONLY v:cv:<track>, v:cvday:<track>:<day>, v:cvuniq:<track>:<day> and never touches any v:cvview* key. Default behaviour is byte-for-byte identical to today.
The 400 invalid-track and 500 unconfigured paths and the non-ok Cloudinary path still return BEFORE the counting block, so failures are never counted.
`day` derivation (`new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)`) and the sha1(x-forwarded-for first hop) visitor derivation are unchanged.
No all-time-unique key is added (no v:cvviewuniq:all) — uniqueness stays a sum of 14 daily PFCOUNTs read by visit-stats.
tasks.verification: Static: `npx tsc --noEmit`. Manual (local `vercel dev`): GET /api/download-cv?track=flutter&mode=view → response header Content-Disposition starts with `inline;`; GET /api/download-cv?track=flutter → `attachment;`. Then inspect Redis: after the view call only `v:cvview:flutter`, `v:cvviewday:flutter:<today>` and `v:cvviewuniq:flutter:<today>` exist for flutter; after the plain call only `v:cv:flutter` etc. increment. Record `TTL v:cvviewday:flutter:<today>` as ~7776000 seconds.
tasks.notes: Blocks any meaningful /cv testing (the page's iframe points at this endpoint). Depends on TASK-01 so the new key family is resettable the moment it starts being written. Open question carried from handoff 03b: whether to add the optional `Range` header guard (architecture §7.5 mitigation) — if adopted, apply it symmetrically to BOTH families and record the choice; if declined, note that the view figure is a reach proxy, not an exact count.

verification_plan.name: Cold load of /cv?track=flutter
steps: Hard-navigate (address bar, full page load) to https://<host>/cv?track=flutter.
Assert the CVView page renders (not NotFound), the Flutter CV track tab is selected, and the embedded PDF loads in the iframe on a fine-pointer desktop.

verification_plan.name: Invalid track

Assert the role="status" notice 'We couldn't find that CV track, showing the Flutter CV instead.' appears above the viewer.
Assert the URL is normalized to ?track=flutter via a replace navigation and the Flutter viewer renders.

verification_plan.name: Mobile / coarse-pointer emulation
steps: In DevTools, emulate a mobile device (width < 768px) and then emulate a coarse pointer (touch).
Reload /cv?track=flutter.
Assert no iframe is rendered and CVFallback reason="coarse-pointer" shows the copy 'Open or download this CV.' with Open PDF and Download buttons.
Tap Open PDF and assert a new tab opens the inline endpoint; tap Download and assert a download starts.
verification_plan.expected: Fallback card instead of a broken iframe; both actions work.

verification_plan.name: Downloads still work and are not converted to views
steps: From the Hero and the Navbar, trigger the Flutter CV download and the Frontend CV download.
Assert the response Content-Disposition is `attachment` (DevTools Network) and the file downloads as before.
Assert no navigation to /cv occurred.
verification_plan.expected: Existing download behaviour is byte-for-byte intact; default mode remains attachment.

verification_plan.name: Counters increment separately
steps: Record the current values of v:cv:flutter and v:cvview:flutter in Redis.
Perform exactly one inline view of /cv?track=flutter and assert ONLY v:cvview:flutter (+ its day/uniq keys) incremented by 1.
Perform exactly one Flutter download and assert ONLY v:cv:flutter (+ its day/uniq keys) incremented by 1.
Assert the two families never increment together.
verification_plan.expected: Views and downloads are counted in strictly separate key families with no cross-write in either direction.
verification_plan.note: If the optional Range guard is adopted, ranged follow-up requests must not increment either counter.

verification_plan.name: Reset flows are non-destructive to each other
steps: Seed both a v:cv:flutter key and a v:cvview:flutter key.
POST /api/visit-reset with {"scope":"cv"} and assert v:cv:flutter is deleted while v:cvview:flutter REMAINS.
Re-seed and POST with {"scope":"cvviews"} and assert v:cvview:flutter is deleted while v:cv:flutter REMAINS.
In the dashboard Danger zone, confirm each of the three buttons resets only its own family.
verification_plan.expected: The cv scope clears downloads only; the cvviews scope clears views only; neither can clear the other.
verification_plan.note: This is the highest-value invariant of revision 2 (ARCH2-02). Record the observed key sets.

verification_plan.name: Stale-client / stale-server robustness and honest zero state
steps: Serve an /api/visit-stats payload WITHOUT the cvViews field and assert the analytics card renders (0 views · 0 unique viewers) instead of throwing.
Serve a payload WITH cvViews and assert the views and downloads numbers are both shown with the labels 'views', 'unique viewers' and 'unique downloaders'.
